events.text: The Andrew Mellon Building was built by Stanley McCormick in 1915.
events.subject: self
events.quote: built by Stanley McCormick , heir to the International Harvester fortune , in 1915

events.text: The Andrew Mellon Building was completed in 1917.
events.subject: self

events.text: After 1941, the building was used for offices and eventually partitioned.
events.subject: self
events.quote: After 1941 , the building was used for offices and eventually partitioned .

events.text: The property was conveyed by deed from Katherine Dexter McCormick to the American Council on Education on March 31, 1950.
events.subject: self
events.quote: conveyed by deed from Katherine Dexter McCormick to the American Council on Education on March 31 , 1950

events.text: The property was conveyed to The Brookings Institution on January 2, 1970.
events.subject: self
events.quote: conveyed to The Brookings Institution on January 2 , 1970

events.text: The building was sold to the National Trust for Historic Preservation on October 28, 1976.
events.subject: self
events.quote: sold to the National Trust for Historic Preservation on October 28 , 1976

events.text: The Andrew Mellon Building was declared a National Historic Landmark in 1976.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The Andrew Mellon Building was declared a National Historic Landmark in 1976 .

events.text: The National Trust put the building up for sale in mid-2009.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The National Trust put the building up for sale in mid-2009 .

events.text: Trust president Richard Moe stepped down in early 2010.
events.subject: other
